description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the AuthenticationService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing user credential setting and validation scenarios.

classes.name: AuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing various credential setting and validation scenarios in AuthenticationService.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Tests setting credentials when the UserService returns null credentials, expecting a failure.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithNotAssignedEss
methods.description: Tests setting credentials when the user role is not 'ESS', expecting an AuthenticationException indicating employee not assigned.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithDisabledUser
methods.description: Tests setting credentials with a disabled user account, expecting an AuthenticationException indicating account disabled.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithTerminatedEmployee
methods.description: Tests setting credentials when the employee is terminated, expecting an AuthenticationException indicating termination.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithoutEmployee
methods.description: Tests setting credentials for a user without an Employee linked, expecting an employee not assigned exception.

methods.name: testsSetCredentials
methods.description: Tests successful setting of credentials for a valid user, verifying session setting and method calls.
